question: Public Distribution System was relaunched by Government of India as ____________in 1997.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Targeted Public Distribution System**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Public Distribution System (PDS) was revamped in June 1997 into the Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS).

• TPDS aims at providing food grains at a subsidized rate to the poor and vulnerable sections of the society.

• Under TPDS, the focus is on providing food grains to families identified as Below Poverty Line (BPL) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY).

• The TPDS is a crucial component of India's food security system, ensuring the availability of food grains at affordable prices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Public Distribution System (PDS)**

• The Public Distribution System (PDS) is an Indian food security system established under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food, and Public Distribution.

• It distributes subsidized food and non-food items to India's poor.

• Major commodities distributed include staple food grains like wheat, rice, sugar, and kerosene, through a network of public distribution shops (PDS) established in several states across the country.

• The system was launched in India in June 1947 with the primary objective of ensuring food security.

• **Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY)**

• Launched by the Government of India in December 2000, it aims to provide highly subsidized food to the poorest of the poor families.

• Under this scheme, each eligible household is entitled to 35 kg of food grains every month at a highly subsidized rate.

• This scheme identifies and targets households in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category who are at the bottom of the economic ladder.

• **Below Poverty Line (BPL)**

• BPL is a benchmark used by the Government of India to indicate economic disadvantage and to identify individuals and households in need of government assistance and aid.

• Various parameters are used to determine BPL status, including income, consumption, and asset-based criteria.

• Households classified as BPL are eligible for various government benefits and subsidies.

• **Food Security**

• Food security refers to the availability of food and individuals' access to it.

• According to the United Nations' Committee on World Food Security, food security is defined as the means that all people, at all times, have physical, social, and economic access to sufficient, safe, and nutritious food that meets their food preferences and dietary needs for an active and healthy life.

• Food security encompasses three dimensions: food availability, food access, and food utilization.
